title: mespilus × smithii
intro: Mespilus × smithii, commonly known as the hybrid medlar, is a deciduous shrub resulting from the cross between Mespilus germanica (European medlar) and Mespilus refasciata (Chinese medlar). The health benefits of Mespilus × smithii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various infections. The bioactive constituents of Mespilus × smithii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and organic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
